title: Skill ci-hygiene gains the once-per-batch CI rule
why: R64, owner 16:01 CST Nov 12: "just update the ci-hygiene skill for now".
note: Skill text only: each suite runs once per batch, on the batch PR, only on the OS whose behaviour it tests; the push to main skips a tree the green batch PR already ran (R61-R63). Scopes the skill part of step ci-hygiene-refresh.
